Denies nausea/vomiting: 'No, no nausea vomiting'; denies fevers: 'Um no, no not that I've noticed'; denies back/flank pain: doctor notes lack of back pain as reassuring and patient did not report any.

MSU/urine for analysis and culture: 'It's probably worth giving us a urine sample today... so we can send it off to the lab... and see exactly what's going on there.'

Fluids: 'make sure you're well hydrated, drink plenty of fluids.'
Paracetamol: 'if you are having some pain, simple Paracetamol, um, would probably be advisable.'

Safety-netting: 'if things still are still not getting any better next week come back and see me' and 'bear in mind those symptoms... fever and the back pain and vomiting. If you have any of those give me a call.'
